# Front Row Insurance

> > Front Row Insurance provides specialized insurance coverage for the entertainment and arts industries across Canada and the United States, including film production, photography, musical instruments, and arts education.

Led by industry experts Grant Patten, David Hamilton, and Casey Budden, Front Row Insurance (Front Row Assurance in French) offers tailored programs including the Protégé Program for arts schools, DICE policies for filmmakers, and specialized coverage through partnerships with organizations like the Canadian League of Composers and Network of Independent Canadian Exhibitors (NICE).

## Key Topics

- Film production insurance
- Photography equipment coverage
- Musical instrument insurance
- Entertainment liability coverage
- Protégé Program (arts education)
- E&O insurance for filmmakers
- DICE policies
- Equipment theft prevention
- Canadian arts insurance
- Concert and festival insurance
- Camera gear protection
- Claims process guidance
- Arts school liability
- Canadian League of Composers partnership

## Film & Video Production Insurance

- [How to choose between a DICE Annual Policy and a Short Shoot policy](https://www.frontrowinsurance.com/articles/how-to-choose-between-a-dice-policy-and-a-short-shoot-policy): Comparison guide for selecting DICE Annual vs Short Shoot film insurance
- [Insurance for filming animals | animals on set and film insurance](https://www.frontrowinsurance.com/articles/insurance-for-filming-animals): Film production insurance for working with animals on set in US & Canada
- [Protecting Your Script with Producer's E&O Insurance](https://www.frontrowinsurance.com/articles/protecting-your-script): E&O insurance for legal defense against film script plagiarism claims
- [E&O Insurance Protects Against Invasion of Privacy and False Light](https://www.frontrowinsurance.com/articles/invasion-of-privacy-and-false-light): E&O coverage for filmmakers against privacy invasion and false light claims
- [RÉCLAMATIONS D'ASSURANCE](https://www.frontrowinsurance.com/fr/blogue/r%C3%A9clamations-dassurance-production-de-films): Guide sur le processus de réclamation d'assurance production de films
- [RAPPORT D'EXAMEN DU SCÉNARIO : POURQUOI EST-IL IMPORTANT ?](https://www.frontrowinsurance.com/fr/blogue/rapports-dexamen-du-sc%C3%A9nario-pourquoi-sont-ils-importants): Importance des rapports d'examen de scénario pour l'assurance film (French)

## Music & Concert Insurance
